items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s where I met Stravinsky one day and freaked out.

ctx.x: I was going to ask about that.
Add Stravinsky and Bernstein in there, and Copland and – what is it? – all the guys.

I just wonder, how do you shift gears? Like, for instance, not only do you transcend the time thing, but you deal with all kinds of styles. I’m wondering, who are the mentors? Did you study the scores of somebody like Ellington or somebody such as . . .
